name: Sins National
overview: Scripture reveals that national sins provoke God's righteous judgment and lead to the defilement of the land, as seen in the grievous offenses of Sodom and Gomorrah and the widespread idolatry of Israel that deeply grieved Moses. The murmuring and rebellion of God's people are ultimately offenses against the LORD himself, not merely against human leaders. These sins bring about consequences such as the land vomiting out its inhabitants and the withdrawal of divine blessings, emphasizing the serious reproach national sin brings upon a people.
